name: pstn_insl_absorber_rod
description: Sensor-driven absorber rod: INSL deck carrying a WIFI/PSCN/TSNS head, a 1px PSTN rod armed with ctype=INSL (so its extension is an insulating absorber), a TTAN guide and a SHLD self-repairing sheath beside it.
why: Save 78400 (Realistic Nuclear Reactor Core): PSTN column x=166 y=151-171 has ctype=INSL, tmp2=16 -- the rod material actually inserted into the pile is insulation, not just structure. Driven from TSNS at (176,131) (94C) via WIFI ch5 + PSCN on the INSL deck at y=130-132; TTAN guide at x=170 and SHLD column at x=171. The only moving absorber found in 37 community reactors that changes core material rather than just position.
